subject: Follow-up: procurement & approvals for Redwood pilot - next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Wu <caroline.wu@clearskyanalytics.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@clearskyanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: procurement & approvals for Redwood pilot - next steps

Hi Caroline — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and a few asks so we can make contracting + procurement straightforward for your pilot: 

TL;DR: ClearSky is comfortable piloting on a credit-card or PO depending on size; Darren (VP Finance) is the economic owner; procurement handles vendor onboarding. To keep momentum, we need a confirm on PO vs card, a signatory name, and procurement contact for vendor forms.

What I captured from the call:
- Pilot scope: 3 seats, 30k tokens/month estimated, 3-month pilot (start target: mid-Aug)
- Purchase path: prefer PO for enterprise deals > $50k/year, otherwise card/payments for pilots
- Marketplace: ClearSky is open to marketplace procurement if vendor onboarding is low friction
- Budget owner: Darren Cho (VP Finance) — Caroline to confirm

Immediate asks: 
1) Caroline: can you confirm whether this pilot will be processed on card or routed to PO (and who signs)?
2) Procurement: who is the intake/portal contact for vendor onboarding? Any vendor questionnaire we should complete?
3) Sean/Marissa/Karthik (internal): I’ll put together a mutual action plan + a PO-ready invoice template if they go that route.

I attached a draft pricing sheet and will drop a MAP shortly. If we can get confirmation on pay-flow and the signatory by EOD Friday it keeps the August start realistic.

Thanks — Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing-sheet-Redwood.pdf (pdf)]

From: Caroline Wu <caroline.wu@clearskyanalytics.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clearskyanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement & approvals for Redwood pilot - next steps

Hi Sean — thanks for the recap and for moving quickly. A few clarifications from my side: 

- Pilot payment: most likely PO for our procurement records if the total commitment is expected to exceed $50k/year. For a small 3-month pilot under ~$15k, we usually approve on card. I need to check with Darren if he prefers to commit the pilot on PO so the pilot invoices sit on the same payment path as future expansion.
- Budget owner: yes, Darren Cho (VP Finance) is the economic owner. I am looping him on the next note for visibility.
- Procurement/contact: procurement@clearskyanalytics.com is the intake alias; lead contact is Ana Morales (ana.morales@clearskyanalytics.com) for onboarding and vendor forms.
- Marketplace: we are evaluating vendor marketplace options but onboarding timeline is longer (2–4 weeks) and requires security attestation and vendor profile. If Redwood can provide a short vendor profile and a sample SOW, that helps.

I'll confirm by EOD whether Darren wants PO for the pilot. Next week would be fine for a 15-min alignment between Darren, Ana, and your team to lock the exact path.

Thanks,
Caroline
Senior Product Manager
ClearSky Analytics

Subject: Internal: ClearSky — procurement path & approver mapping

Marissa / Karthik — quick internal follow-up off Caroline's reply. Key data points to map into the opportunity: 

- Economic buyer: Darren Cho (VP Finance) — will confirm PO preference
- Procurement intake: procurement@clearskyanalytics.com (Ana Morales lead) — needs vendor profile + security attestation for marketplace
- Decision rule: PO if > $50k/year, card for small pilots <$20k

Suggested internal asks / owners:
- Marissa: price/concession recommendation if they insist on PO for pilot (we may need a short-term invoice net-30 to match finance cadence)
- Karthik: prepare a one-page vendor profile + sample SOW and security snapshot (SOC2/hosting) — attach for Ana
- Sean: schedule 15-min sync with Darren + Ana. I’ll include a MAP and PO-ready invoice template.

If Darren confirms PO we should prepare an invoice that lists ClearSky billing address and the authorized signatory. If they want to purchase via marketplace we should ask our partner ops to confirm MPN onboarding SLA.

I will draft the MAP and send to Caroline to get sign-off.

—Sean

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: ClearSky — procurement path & approver mapping

Thanks Sean — short answers and next moves from my side: 

1) Pricing / concessions: For a 3-month $12–15k pilot, recommend we keep standard list pricing and offer a single-term pilot credit (10%) if they commit to a 12-month renewal within 60 days of pilot end. If they insist on PO and require net-30, we can accept but request PO includes a clause for renewal pricing or a cap — avoids an open-ended discount request.

2) Approver/Signatory map (proposed): 
- Economic buyer: Darren Cho (VP Finance) — final approval on budget allocation
- Finance sponsor: Caroline Wu (Senior PM) — day-to-day billing liaison
- Procurement intake: Ana Morales / procurement@clearskyanalytics.com — vendor onboarding/questionnaire
- Legal signatory: Head of Legal (we should ask for name if contract > $50k)

3) Ask to Karthik: please get vendor profile and sample SOW ready by Monday. Add a short security snapshot (SOC2 + hosting region) — procurement will ask.

I’ll draft a short MAP with milestones and invoice cadence. Once we have Darren on a quick call we should be able to close the pilot purchase path.

—Marissa
Account Executive Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

Subject: Mutual action plan + asks to confirm purchase path (15-min sync request)

Hi Caroline / Darren / Ana — following internal alignment, attached is a short mutual action plan and the draft pricing we discussed. Key points and asks before we schedule a 15-min sync: 

1) Purchase path: please confirm whether ClearSky will process this 3-month pilot on card or issue a PO/net-30. If PO, confirm the authorized signatory name and billing address.
2) Vendor intake: Ana — can you confirm the preferred vendor intake packet and a target SLA for vendor onboarding? Karthik will send the vendor profile + sample SOW by EOD Monday.
3) Marketplace: if you prefer marketplace procurement, please state which marketplace (AWS/Azure/GCP/Other) and we will kick off partner ops. Marketplace onboarding typically adds 2–4 weeks.
4) Timeline: if we get confirmation on purchase path this week, we can issue a PO-ready invoice and start the pilot the week of Aug 23.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx; pricing-sheet-Redwood.pdf

Proposed 15-min sync options (PST): Tue 8/11 10:00am, Tue 8/11 3:00pm, Wed 8/12 9:00am — let me know what works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks for helping move this forward — Sean
